name: item-track-merge
what: rt-sync2 judge step 5 / Recommendation 2: an item moved to another track by one computer while another nudges it, both made apart. The merge (mirror.event_file) copies the winner's fields and merges only the state, and the track an item sits on is a field, not part of the state: when the nudge is the newer side (here a higher rev: James's nudge comes past SESSION_SECS, so it isn't rev 1 any more), the move is lost on every computer, and each log says "both changes are kept". Reproduced 2026-11-27 at bf500ba. The oracle can't see it (all three agree), so the check says what each person did must stand: Bass 1 on Gtr (Bee) at 33.25 s (James).
signature: intent:James: Bass # sits on Gtr (Bee's move) a

edits.lua: reaper.MoveMediaItemToTrack(item('Bass 1'), track('Gtr')); return 'moved Bass 1 to Gtr'

checks.what: Bass 1 sits on Gtr (Bee's move) at 33.25 s (James's nudge)
checks.lua: local it = item('Bass 1'); assert(it, 'Bass 1 is gone'); assert(it.track == track('Gtr'), 'Bass 1 is on ' .. tostring(it.track and it.track.name) .. ', not Gtr'); assert(math.abs(reaper.GetMediaItemInfo_Value(it, 'D_POSITION') - 33.25) < 1e-6, 'Bass 1 is at ' .. reaper.GetMediaItemInfo_Value(it, 'D_POSITION'))
